doc:
Item 11.6: open-set retrieval with unknown identities, false matches, calibrated refusal, retrieval utility.

PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN (2026-10-07, wave 2):
  Setup. Per draw, half of the identities of a cache are 'unknown': their gallery tracklets are removed from
  the gallery (queries of unknown identities stay as probes), the other half are 'known'. The decision rule is
  label-free: every probe is matched against the gallery of known identities after removing same-camera
  candidates (camera id is available before the decision); the top-1 similarity s1 is accepted when s1 >= tau,
  otherwise the system refuses. A known probe is valid when a cross-camera same-identity tracklet remains.
  Draws: 20 identity splits (seeds 0..19) per encoder; encoders s0, s1 (retrained) and g002 (locked
  attention checkpoint; no validation cache, so only the gallery-based calibration applies to it).
  Calibration sources for tau at target false-accept rate (FAR) 1, 5, 10 percent:
    val : pooled unknown-probe scores on the validation cache (12 held-out training identities, 20 splits),
    loo : leave-one-identity-out on the enrolled gallery itself (each enrolled identity's tracklets probe the
          gallery without that identity; pooled top-1 scores),
    oracle : the test unknown-probe scores themselves (reference, not deployable).
  Hypotheses and falsification criteria (written before running):
   H1 (refusal helps): with tau calibrated at 5 percent FAR, the precision of accepted decisions
      (accepted and correct known match / accepted) exceeds the no-refusal precision (correct known / all
      valid probes) with an identity-cluster 95 percent CI excluding zero. FALSIFIED if the interval includes 0.
   H2 (calibration transfers): the realised test FAR of the val and loo thresholds is within 2.5 points of the
      target at 5 percent in the identity-cluster interval. FALSIFIED if the interval excludes target +- 2.5.
   H3 (unknown rejection is informative): AUROC of s1 for known-valid versus unknown probes exceeds 0.5 with all
      20 draws above 0.5 for both retrained encoders. FALSIFIED otherwise.
  Intervals: identity-cluster bootstrap (2,000 resamples) of ratios of sums over identities, pooling draws.
Outputs results/w2_openset.json.
usage: python3 -I w2_openset.py
